youtube.title: HRVOJE MORIC: Geopolitical Journalist & Podcaster: Cyber Attacks – The Gateway to Digital Control?
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan talks to geopolitical journalist and podcaster Hrvoje Morić on the growing wave of cyber attacks and the potential push towards digital IDs, biometric verification and greater control over online activity. They explore the role of AI, automation and mass job displacement, the future of global governance and whether geopolitical tensions and the Ukraine conflict are helping accelerate a new technological order. For further information visit Hrvoje’s website Geopolitics & Empire or find him on X

youtube.title: PAUL HENRY: ACT MP: ACT Pushing for a Genuine Three-Party Coalition
youtube.summary: ACT MP Paul Henry joins Maree Buske to discuss the uncertain post-election numbers, the prospects of a returning centre-right government and the possibility of a hung Parliament. He argues that any new coalition must operate as a genuine partnership between National, ACT and NZ First, rather than National simply managing separate agreements. youtube.title: RIDING SHOTGUN: With Rachel Stewart: When Journalism Lost Its Way We All Did
youtube.summary: Rachel Stewart reflects on the state of democracy following the election, arguing that declining trust in politicians, institutions and ourselves is being fuelled by mainstream media manipulation. Drawing parallels between the Covid vaccine mandates and reactions to strategic voting, she questions how much freedom and choice we really have, and calls for the destruction of mainstream media as a necessary step towards restoring independent thought and trust. youtube.title: BOTH BARRELS: The Cost to Youth with Pornography’s Digital Explosion
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke and Rachel Stewart examine how pornography has evolved from hidden magazines to an instantly accessible, multi-billion-dollar online industry, and the growing impact on children, relationships and intimacy. They discuss the increasingly extreme nature of online content, the normalisation of harmful sexual behaviours, early exposure among teenagers and the emerging threat of AI-generated sexual imagery and deepfakes. For more on this topic watch Riding Shotgun: A Check Mate on Your Porn Discover more from Rachel on Substack and X

youtube.title: NICK SMITH: Nelson Mayor: The Case for Protecting Electorate MPs
youtube.summary: Talking with Simon O’Connor, former National MP and Nelson mayor Nick Smith challenges criticism of the 2026 election results, arguing that strategic voting has been overstated and that electorate MPs play an essential role in representing local communities. He warns against proposed changes that could undermine electorate representation, calls for electoral law to be protected from political tinkering through a supermajority or referendum and makes the case for a four-year parliamentary term and a simpler supplementary member voting system.
